purpose: Human-readable prompt descriptions for runtime LLM calls in pipeline/. Runtime code does not read this file.

prompt_conventions.placeholder_style: Placeholders are wrapped in braces, for example {role}.
prompt_conventions.rendering: Templates shown as arrays of lines are joined with newline characters. List placeholders such as {output_contract_bullets} are rendered as one bullet per item.

prompts.description: Shared system-prompt scaffold used by pipeline LLM calls that require strict JSON output and grounded responses.
template_lines: Return exactly one JSON object and no markdown.
Only use entities, signals, ports, values, and relationships that are explicitly present in the provided context.
If the context is insufficient, return the safest empty or fallback value instead of inventing information.

placeholders.role: Runtime role string supplied by the stage-specific caller.
placeholders.task_goal: Runtime goal string supplied by the stage-specific caller.
placeholders.output_contract_bullets: One '- ...' bullet per required output-contract item.

prompts.description: Generates MBSE-grounded verification task-set candidates from a requirement and MBSE context.

system_prompt_parameters.role: an MBSE verification task decomposition assistant
system_prompt_parameters.task_goal: Decompose the requirement into MBSE-grounded verification task sets that preserve the current requirement objective.
output_contract: "task_goal_summary" must restate the current requirement objective in one short sentence.
"task_sets" must be a list with at most the requested number of candidates.
Each task set must contain "rationale", optional "task_goal_summary", and "tasks".
validity_rules: Do not invent components, component types, ports, or signals outside the provided MBSE context.
Every task objective must support the given requirement, not a different engineering goal.
If a field cannot be grounded to the MBSE context, return an empty list or empty object for that field.
Acceptance criteria may only contain metrics that are explicit in the requirement or directly tied to grounded signals.

prompts.description: Chooses one candidate when multiple FMI port-binding candidates tie on score.

system_prompt_parameters.task_goal_template: Choose exactly one port-binding candidate that realizes MBSE connection {source_component}.{source_signal} -> {target_component}.{target_signal}.
output_contract: "selected_index" must be one of the candidate indices provided by the user.
"reason" must be a short explanation grounded in the provided connection and candidate port names.
validity_rules: Do not invent new ports or indices.
Choose only from the provided candidates.
Prefer the candidate whose source and target ports best preserve the intended MBSE signal flow.
If the candidates are indistinguishable, return index 0.

prompts.description: Synthesizes a minimal adapter payload for a detected discrepancy on a selected FMI connection edge.

system_prompt_parameters.task_goal_template: Synthesize the minimal valid adapter spec that repairs discrepancy {discrepancy_kind} on edge {source_fmu}.{source_signal} -> {target_fmu}.{target_signal} without changing the task intent.
output_contract: "transform" must be a JSON object that only contains fields supported by the discrepancy details.
"notes" must be a short list of implementation notes.
validity_rules: Do not invent new signals, units, dimensions, or execution semantics not present in the discrepancy details.
The adapter must solve only the current edge mismatch, not redesign the model.
If uncertain, keep the discrepancy kind and reuse the conservative fallback transform.
Return compact notes and avoid generic explanations.
